name: Code Review
description: An agent of your choice reviews pull requests on the repositories you pick, and you decide what of it reaches the pull request.

screenshots.caption: The Reviews page with a review waiting to be published
A review thread with its pull request and verdict

permissions.reason: To find the project whose repository a pull request is in.
To watch your repositories for pull requests and read what they change.
To post a review when you publish one, or automatically if you choose that.
Each review is a thread in which your chosen agent reviews the pull request.
The reviewing agent reports its verdict and comments through a tool of this plugin.

settings.label: Source control host
settings.description: GitHub uses the gh login of this MC's machine.

settings.label: Repositories
settings.description: owner/name of each repository to watch. Each needs a project on this MC.

settings.label: Review when you are asked to review
settings.description: Only when asked: a review request to the gh user starts a review.

settings.label: Label that asks for a review
settings.description: Only when asked. Leave empty to turn off.

settings.label: Comment that asks for a review
settings.description: Only when asked: a comment starting with this starts a review. Leave empty to turn off.

settings.label: Ignored authors
settings.description: Pull requests by these logins are never reviewed automatically.

settings.label: Largest change reviewed automatically
settings.description: Lines added and removed. 0 for no limit.

settings.label: Review new pushes
settings.description: Review a pull request again when its head changes after a review.

settings.label: Agent
settings.description: The provider instance that reviews, such as claudeAgent or codex.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Empty for the agent's default model.

settings.label: Access
settings.description: The agent works in its own checkout of the pull request, which runs the pull request's code if the agent runs commands.

settings.label: Review prompt
settings.default:
Review pull request #{{pr.number}} "{{pr.title}}" in {{repository}} by {{pr.author}}, which merges {{pr.head}} into {{pr.base}}.

Your working directory is a checkout of the pull request's head. The change is `git diff {{pr.mergeBase}} HEAD`; read the code around it where that helps.

Look for bugs, security problems, missing tests and changes that break callers. Leave out style a formatter or linter would catch. Comment only where you are confident, and say what to do about it.
settings.description: {{pr.number}}, {{pr.title}}, {{pr.author}}, {{pr.base}}, {{pr.head}}, {{pr.headSha}}, {{pr.mergeBase}}, {{pr.url}} and {{repository}} are filled in. How to report the findings is added after it.

settings.label: Instructions per repository
settings.description: Added to the prompt for that repository, as {"owner/name": "text"}.

settings.label: Follow REVIEW.md
settings.description: Add the REVIEW.md at the pull request's head to the prompt.

settings.label: Show reviews
settings.description: On the Reviews page only, review threads stay out of the thread list.

settings.label: Post verdicts as comments
settings.description: Post reviews as comments rather than approvals or change requests.
